name: OpenHands Agent Canvas (Branch Auto-Update, No Docker)
install_cmd: ACCOUNT_HOME="${ACCOUNT_HOME:-/home/sabashop}"; HELPER="$PWD/host-helpers/install-openhands-host.sh"; [ -r "$HELPER" ] || { echo "ERROR: OpenHands helper is missing from the deployed branch: $HELPER" >&2; exit 1; }; bash "$HELPER" install --home "$ACCOUNT_HOME" --no-start
start_cmd: ACCOUNT_HOME="${ACCOUNT_HOME:-/home/sabashop}"; HELPER="$PWD/host-helpers/install-openhands-host.sh"; [ -r "$HELPER" ] || { echo "ERROR: OpenHands helper is missing from the deployed branch: $HELPER" >&2; exit 1; }; exec bash "$HELPER" run --home "$ACCOUNT_HOME"
